result.title: StereoGaussians: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Stereo Images
result.summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables reconstruction without per- scene optimisation, but practical stereo-camera applications require nearby-view extrapolation beyond the input views. Stereo depth anchors visible surfaces, yet rendering newly exposed regions also requires learned appearance and additional scene capacity. We introduce StereoGaussians, which predicts a metric 3DGS representation from a single calibrated stereo pair. It reuses intermediate repre- sentations from frozen pretrained stereo networks to predict Gaussian attributes, while calibrated disparity anchors the geometry. A second Gaussian layer and an expanded image canvas provide capacity for disoccluded and outside-field-of- view content. For training, we construct SceneSplat-Stereo from quality-filtered 3DGS teachers, pairing stereo inputs with nearby target views across 803 training scenes. Experiments on unseen real and photorealistic stereo benchmarks demon- strate improvements over strong view-synthesis baselines, while ablation studies support our main design choices.

AI.brief_summary: 从标定立体图像对前馈预测度量 3D 高斯表示，借助冻结立体网络的中间特征与视差锚定几何，并用第二层高斯与扩展画布补足新暴露区域，在新建 SceneSplat-Stereo 上训练并评测新视角合成。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于前馈 3D 重建与新视角合成工作，关注的是渲染容量和外推画布，未涉及 VLM 推理中的 latent 状态生成、证据获取或停止决策等主线问题，也无明确可迁移的状态或决策线索。
